## Pre-registered effects (arm full)

1. Maximum block span >= 20: 20.0 -> **fails**.
2. First session with span >= 80 in [250, 865]: per seed [None, None, None] -> **fails, never**; span at 865 16.6 [15.1-19.3] (DD 104).
3. 4-digit error > 3-digit error (250-865): 0.306 vs 0.204 -> **holds** (EPAM 3.0% vs 1.5%).
4. Prior speeds early learning (span s50 full vs prioroff): 11.2 vs 8.8 -> **holds**.
5. Letter probe final <= 9 at every probe: max 11 -> **fails**.
- randlabel: span s865 full vs randlabel per seed [('15.3', '16.1'), ('19.3', '15.5'), ('15.1', '16.3')] -> full beats it on every seed: **False**.
- store8: span s865 full vs store8 per seed [('15.3', '70.3'), ('19.3', '60.1'), ('15.1', '79.1')] -> full beats it on every seed: **False**.
- linkloose: span s865 full vs linkloose per seed [('15.3', '21.6'), ('19.3', '15.1'), ('15.1', '16.9')] -> full beats it on every seed: **False**.
